message.content:
**MSFT** is the ticker symbol for **Microsoft Corporation** on the U.S. stock exchanges (NASDAQ).  
On Yahoo Finance you can view its full profile, price chart, financials, news, and analyst estimates by visiting:

```
https://finance.yahoo.com/quote/MSFT
```

or simply typing “MSFT” into the search bar on the Yahoo Finance homepage.

**Quick facts about Microsoft (MSFT)**  
| Item | Detail |
|------|--------|
| Exchange | NASDAQ |
| Sector | Technology |
| Industry | Software—Infrastructure |
| Market Cap | ~$2.5 trillion (as of 2026) |
| CEO | Satya Nadella |
| Headquarters | Redmond, Washington, USA |

If you need more specific data (e.g., current price, P/E ratio, dividend yield, recent news), just open the link above and explore the tabs on the page.
